SWAP/rootextraction.f90.relevance: Read-only root-temperature frost modifier exists separately; outside B1 hydraulic-boundary implementation scope

SWAP/MOD_MvG_functions.f90.relevance: Frost K/dKdh constitutive scaling; B1.11 must retain SWAP-011 derivative consistency

activation_and_call_order.input: readswap.f90 reads SWFROST and, when active, TFROSTSTA/TFROSTEND
per_step_order: SWAP calls FrozenCond(tsoil,tetop) before root extraction and the Richards/boundary work
FrozenCond reads the current temperature profile owned by the temperature process and computes RFCP and frost-depth projections
BoundBottom and drainage consume RFCP/frozen-depth-derived hydraulic inputs
FrozenBounds runs after Drain(2) and before SoilWater(2), modifying trial boundary/drainage fluxes
SoilTemperature(2) runs after the hydraulic solve at the end of the interval; the next interval recomputes frost effects from its resulting accepted profile

state_and_effect_census.thermal_state_owner: existing soil-temperature profile/state; frost reads it and does not own or advance temperature
state_and_effect_census.physical_frost_storage: No explicit ice-content or frost water/energy storage is present in these source routines.
state_and_effect_census.restart_candidate: Thresholds remain run configuration. RFCP and frost-depth projections are recomputable from the restored accepted temperature profile, grid and thresholds at the next interval; this is source-topology evidence, not a qualified SWAP5 restart claim.
state_and_effect_census.rollback_candidate: FrozenBounds changes hydraulic trial boundary/drainage quantities, not an independent frost state or receipt. Full retry rollback remains owned by the hydraulic interval and requires runtime qualification.

hydraulic_transfer_trace.conductivity: hconduc applies K_eff = K_base*rfcp + hconode_vsmall*(1-rfcp) when frost is active
hydraulic_transfer_trace.conductivity_derivative: dhconduc applies dK_eff/dh = dK_base/dh*rfcp when frost is active; the base derivative must retain corrected B1.11 SWAP-011 semantics
hydraulic_transfer_trace.drainage_boundary: FrozenBounds uses frost depth, available air volume, drainage topology and RFCP; it may close qbot, remove frozen-layer drainage, redistribute drainage, or call divdra
hydraulic_transfer_trace.mass_owner: the existing Richards/drainage boundary ledger; frost has no independent water-mass receipt
hydraulic_transfer_trace.snow_order: Snow is called before FrozenCond in the SWAP interval loop; coupled snow/frost behavior remains outside the pure B2 factor slice

next_preregistered_slice: PPA-WU05-B2 typed pure frost factor and hydraulic K/dKdh algebra oracle; no runtime composition
